limits: First nonblack frame is not application-ready; an absent marker is not invented.
Pixel updates and delivered callbacks are observations, not complete or physical display FPS.
Position-change counts remain within each lane and unit; ticks and degrees are not numerically compared.
Rendered joint observations are actual presentation traces, not physical servo evidence.
Input acknowledgement alone does not prove application response or navigation.
Runtime preparation includes observed cache state; cold/warm labels do not prove comparable network cache conditions.
No baseline, competitor or older-runtime result is recomputed or inherited.
Missing fields remain null/NOTCAPTURED, and raw failures remain traceable by immutable report hash.
